description: This file defines the Marketing model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve marketing data by code and to add marketing reports to the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for managing marketing-related database operations, including retrieving marketing info by code and creating marketing report entries.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves marketing data from the database matching a specific code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a new marketing report record into the database with provided marketing ID, IP address, and country.
